p0_findings.finding: The published/unverified handler checks quarantine target absence and regular non-symlink PASS marker before renaming the marker. Either check can die after traps were disabled, leaving canonical RUN_COMPLETE in place. A quarantine-path race after the prepublish gate is a direct reachable witness.
p0_findings.minimal_fix: Make atomic PASS-marker neutralization the handler's first physical action once published/unverified is established. Only then check quarantine collision and move the directory; all later failures may leave a failed canonical but never a PASS canonical.

p1_findings.finding: Waiting only covers an already-running exact watcher tag and has no timeout or periodic state receipt.
A noncooperating launch can race after the second query, and exact one-A800 UUID/model/driver/index0 is not enforced.
Major import roots and dangerous environment variables are handled, but repo-root shadows and DSEC sample-content identity remain incomplete.
Before final publication, attempt/result failures leave ambiguous non-rerunnable artifacts without FAILED_DO_NOT_CITE or partial quarantine.
Final semantics do not re-cross-check all factor receipt artifact hashes and only type-check the propagated M513 identity.
Postverify now counts every entry and checks all hashes, but does not explicitly recheck exact completion text or JSON schema/status/claim boundaries.
The persisted END SHA is sampled before final staging, sealing, publication and postverification; no true-end fourth sample is recorded.

decision.reason: Quarantine is now strict after marker neutralization, but two early checks can still exit first and leave a canonical PASS marker. P0 must be zero before launch.
required_before_r6: make PASS-marker neutralization the first published-unverified physical action
move quarantine collision and all other fallible checks after neutralization
